mapper.select: SELECT id, code, channel, title_template, body_template, variables_schema::text AS variables_schema, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ainer_notification_template WHERE code = #{code} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, code, channel, title_template, body_template, variables_schema::text AS variables_schema, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM ainer_notification_template WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_notification_template SET title_template = COALESCE(#{titleTemplate}, title_template), body_template = COALESCE(#{bodyTemplate}, body_template), variables_schema = COALESCE(#{variablesSchema}::jsonb, variables_schema), version = #{newVersion}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
